As Brand Manager for E-commerce Quick-Commerce, you will own the strategic growth, performance and positioning of partner brands across leading marketplaces and Quick-Commerce platforms (e.g., Amazon Seller Vendor Central, Flipkart, Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart).

title: Technical Project Manager-(CCAAS & Voice BOT Delivery)
jobDescription:
About Exotel

Exotel is the emerging market s leading AI-powered Customer Engagement Platform, enabling enterprises to engage customers seamlessly across Voice, Messaging, Video, Contact Centre and Conversational AI. Trusted by over 6,000 businesses across 60+ countries-including Ola, Swiggy, Flipkart, HDFC Bank and Zomato-Exotel powers more than 50 million customer interactions every day.

As enterprises increasingly adopt AI-first customer engagement solutions, Exotel is at the forefront of delivering highly scalable, secure and enterprise-grade deployments across Contact Centre, CPaaS and Conversational AI.

Location: Bangalore or Gurgaon

About the Role

We are looking for a Technical Project Manager to own the end-to-end delivery of complex enterprise implementations across Exotel s Customer Engagement portfolio. You will operate as the single-threaded owner for customer deployments, driving projects from kickoff through production go-live, hypercare and operational handover.

This is not a traditional project management role. You will be responsible for ensuring successful delivery of technically complex, integration-heavy implementations while maintaining governance across timelines, scope, risks, commercial milestones and customer expectations.

Working closely with customers and cross-functional teams-including Sales, Pre-Sales, Solution Architecture, Product, Engineering, Support, Customer Success and Finance-you will ensure every deployment is delivered on time, within scope and to the highest quality standards.

The ideal candidate combines strong project management discipline with technical aptitude, thrives in ambiguous environments, and has a proven ability to drive execution across multiple enterprise projects simultaneously.

Key Responsibilities Program Project Governance
  • Own the complete project lifecycle for multiple concurrent enterprise implementations from project initiation through production handover.
  • Build and maintain detailed project plans, milestones, RAID logs, dependency trackers and governance dashboards.
  • Define and enforce stage gates and entry/exit criteria across Kickoff, Solution Design, Development, UAT, Go-Live, Hypercare and Handover.
  • Drive regular governance reviews and provide accurate project health updates to customer and executive stakeholders.

End-to-End Delivery Execution
  • Lead enterprise implementations across Contact Centre, Voice, Conversational AI and customer engagement solutions.
  • Drive execution against committed timelines while balancing scope, quality and customer expectations.
  • Coordinate implementation activities across internal teams and external customer stakeholders to ensure timely project delivery.
  • Ensure all commercial, technical and operational milestones are achieved before project closure.
Customer Stakeholder Management
  • Act as the primary customer-facing delivery lead throughout the implementation lifecycle.
  • Build trusted relationships with enterprise customers and manage communication across business and technical stakeholders.
  • Lead project governance meetings, steering committees, technical workshops and executive status reviews.
  • Communicate risks, dependencies and delivery updates with clarity and confidence.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Collaborate closely with Solution Architects, Engineering and Product teams to translate customer requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Coordinate activities across Sales, Customer Success, Support and Finance to ensure smooth project execution.
  • Build solution documentation, Low-Level Designs (LLDs), implementation plans and Scope of Work (SOW) documents.
  • Drive alignment across teams to resolve blockers and accelerate project delivery.

Technical Delivery Enterprise Readiness
  • Coordinate complex enterprise integrations involving REST APIs, Webhooks, CRM platforms (Salesforce, Zendesk, Freshdesk), authentication systems, databases and third-party applications.
  • Manage enterprise deployment requirements including maintenance windows, change management processes and production readiness.
  • Coordinate customer Information Security reviews, compliance questionnaires, architecture reviews and deployment approvals.
  • Ensure customer environments are fully prepared for successful production deployments.

Risk, Scope Escalation Management
  • Proactively identify project risks, technical challenges and execution bottlenecks before they impact delivery.
  • Manage project scope through structured change management and prevent uncontrolled scope creep.
  • Drive timely resolution of customer and internal escalations through effective stakeholder management.
  • Maintain clear visibility into dependencies and ensure mitigation plans are actively tracked.

UAT, Go-Live, Hypercare Handover
  • Own User Acceptance Testing (UAT) planning, execution and customer sign-offs.
  • Coordinate production readiness assessments and Go-Live activities.
  • Lead post-production hypercare until solution stabilisation.
  • Ensure seamless transition to Customer Success and Support teams with complete operational documentation.

Qualifications

Experience

  • 6-8 years of experience in Technical Project Management, Program Management or Enterprise Delivery.
  • Proven experience delivering customer-facing enterprise software implementations in SaaS, CPaaS, CCaaS, Telecom or Cloud technology environments.
  • Strong track record of managing multiple concurrent enterprise deployments.

Technical Knowledge

  • Good understanding of enterprise software implementations involving APIs, REST integrations, Webhooks and cloud-based applications.
  • Working knowledge of Linux, networking fundamentals and SIP-based telephony is highly desirable.
  • Familiarity with Voice infrastructure, RTP streams, codecs and enterprise communication platforms is a plus.
  • Exposure to enterprise Information Security processes, SOC 2, architecture reviews and data privacy standards is desirable.

Project Management

  • Strong experience managing project plans, RAID logs, dependency tracking and governance frameworks.
  • Hands-on experience with Jira, Confluence, Salesforce or similar project management tools.
  • Ability to execute projects using Agile, Waterfall or hybrid delivery methodologies depending on customer requirements.

Leadership Communication

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical teams and executive stakeholders.
  • Strong stakeholder management, negotiation and conflict resolution skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive outcomes in ambiguous, fast-paced and cross-functional environments.
  • High ownership, accountability and bias for execution.

Key Responsibilities


1) ML & Deep Learning Model Development

  • Design, train, and optimize ML models for prediction, classification, ranking, time-series forecasting, anomaly detection, NLP, and recommendation use cases.
  • Build robust experimentation workflows (train/validation strategy, ablations, error analysis) and improve model quality through iterative tuning.
  • Ensure reproducibility and maintainability through clean code practices, versioning, and automated testing.

2) GenAI Engineering (LLMs, RAG / MCP / fine-tuning, Agents)

  • Build enterprise-grade LLM applications using RAG (retrieval-augmented generation), MCP, and fine-tuning approaches: chunking strategies, embedding generation, hybrid retrieval, reranking, prompt templates, and citation/attribution patterns.
  • Develop LLM applications with tool use/function calling patterns and agentic workflows where appropriate.
  • Implement systematic evaluation: curated eval sets, prompt regression tests, hallucination checks, retrieval quality metrics, and automated quality gates.

3) ML & LLM Operations: Productionization, Deployment & Monitoring

  • Deploy and operate real-time and batch inference solutions on Azure using managed endpoints and/or containerized serving.
  • Build CI/CD for ML systems: automated packaging, container builds, model validation tests, staged rollouts, and rollback strategies.
  • Establish lifecycle management: model registry/versioning, lineage, promotion workflows, and release governance.
  • Implement observability: latency, throughput, cost, drift signals, data quality checks, alerts, and performance degradation monitoring.

4) Pipeline Orchestration & Automation (Train Deploy)

  • Build standardized ML pipelines for training, evaluation, and deployment using orchestration tools (cloud-native pipelines and/or platform tools).
  • Automate dataset/version management, feature generation, scheduled retraining triggers, and approval workflows.
  • Define repeatable patterns for scalable experimentation and reliable production delivery.

5) Analytics Products, Dashboards & Data Governance

  • Own key analytics outputs as products (dashboards, reusable datasets, internal tools), continuously improving them based on usage patterns and performance gaps.
  • Build and automate dashboards and analytical components using scalable SQL logic, Python transformations, and reusable modules.

  • Implement guardrails: prompt injection defenses, sensitive data protections, output validation, and secure tool execution patterns.

About the Role

We have a mature, production iOS application (a brownfield codebase) that we are transforming into an AI-powered product and changing how we build it. We are looking for a Senior iOS Developer who can do both: modernize and re-architect the existing app to embed AI capabilities into the core user experience, and lead the transition to an AI-led development model where engineers build with AI assistants as the default way of working. Claude is our primary AI tool and a high priority in this role — you will use Claude and Claude Code daily to understand legacy code, plan safe refactors, generate and review changes, and accelerate delivery, and you will set the standard for how the iOS team adopts AI-led development. This is a hands-on senior role for an engineer who is an excellent iOS craftsperson, comfortable working inside a large existing codebase, and energized by AI-driven development.

What You'll Do

Brownfield Transformation

  • Understand & re-architect: Take ownership of the existing production iOS app: understand its architecture, dependencies, and technical debt, then plan and execute a safe, incremental migration toward an AI-powered product.
  • Modernize safely: Refactor and modernize legacy code without breaking existing functionality — introducing modern patterns, improving test coverage, and de-risking each change with feature flags and staged rollouts.
  • Embed AI into the product: Integrate AI/LLM capabilities directly into the app's core experience — assistant/chat, summarization, semantic search, personalization, and agentic flows — on the existing iOS stack.
  • Protect what works: Maintain backward compatibility, data integrity, and release stability throughout the transformation.

AI-Led Development (High Priority — Claude First)

  • Claude-first workflow: Use Claude and Claude Code as your default tool for reading and mapping legacy code, planning refactors, writing and reviewing changes, generating tests, and debugging — and champion best practices for prompting, context management, and reviewing AI-generated code.
  • Set the standard: Establish AI-led development practices for the iOS team: workflows, guardrails, code-review norms for AI output, and measurable productivity and quality improvements.
  • LLM integration: Integrate the Anthropic API / Claude and other model providers into the iOS app (Swift) — handling auth, streaming responses, tool/function calling, retries, and secure key management via a backend.
  • Quality & safety: Put evaluation, prompt versioning, cost/latency budgeting, and observability in place so AI features are measurable and reliable — not guesswork.

Core iOS Engineering

  • Work across a production Swift/Objective-C iOS codebase and drive migration toward modern architecture (SwiftUI, Swift Concurrency, Combine, MVVM).
  • Own performance, memory, battery, and stability across devices and iOS versions.
  • Raise test coverage with unit and UI tests (XCTest, XCUITest) to make refactors safe.
  • Manage the App Store release pipeline, code signing, provisioning, and TestFlight rollouts.

Ownership & Collaboration

  • Lead migration workstreams end to end — planning, architecture, implementation, review, release, and post-launch iteration.
  • Partner with product, design, backend, and ML/AI teams to sequence the transformation and ship measurable value in stages.
  • Mentor engineers on both legacy-codebase craft and effective, responsible use of AI tooling.

What We're Looking For

Must-Have

  • 5–8 years of professional iOS development, with strong Swift expertise (and comfort with legacy Objective-C).
  • Deep experience with modern iOS architecture and incremental migration to SwiftUI / Swift Concurrency.
  • Proven track record shipping and maintaining production apps on the App Store.
  • Proven experience working in and refactoring large, existing (brownfield) production codebases — not just greenfield projects.
  • Strong instinct for safe, incremental migration: feature flags, backward compatibility, automated testing, and staged rollouts.
  • Demonstrable enthusiasm for AI-led development and hands-on experience with Claude, Claude Code, or comparable AI coding assistants.
  • Experience integrating REST/GraphQL and, ideally, LLM/ML APIs into a shipping app.

Why Join Us

  • Own a real transformation — take a mature product and make it AI-native, with senior-level autonomy.
  • Help define how the whole team builds with AI, not just contribute to it.
  • First-class AI tooling (Claude and more) provided and actively encouraged.

Deliver

  • Lead delivery of DPIAs, ROPA build-outs, privacy program gap assessments, GDPR/DPDP/EU AI Act compliance programs, cross-border transfer assessments (SCCs, adequacy), and privacy notice/policy reviews.

  • Build and maintain DPIA templates, ROPA templates, legitimate interest assessment frameworks, and AI governance/impact assessment templates mapped to EU AI Act risk tiers.

  • Partner with Sales/SE/CS on privacy-attach opportunities.

AI-enabled productization

  • Build AI-assisted DPIA/ROPA generation playbooks with mandatory human validation gates privacy work carries more interpretive and liability weight than technical control mapping, so review gates should be heavier, not lighter.

Quality & risk

  • Support customers navigating regulator inquiries or breach-notification timelines in an advisory capacity only.

Experience

  • 5+ years in privacy consulting, DPO/privacy office roles, or in-house privacy program ownership.

  • Hands-on DPIA and ROPA delivery at scale not just policy drafting.

Domain mastery

  • Deep: GDPR, Indias DPDP Act.

  • Working knowledge: EU AI Act, US state privacy laws, and awareness of other regional frameworks (PDPL, PIPL).

  • Legal background (JD/LLM, or paralegal/compliance-law experience) enough to read and interpret regulatory text independently for routine questions. Not a requirement; treat as a differentiator, not a filter, given how narrow this combination is in the market.

AI-enabled workflow proficiency

  • Demonstrated use of AI tools to reduce manual effort and standardize deliverables.

  • Able to translate domain expertise into reusable templates and guided systems.

Operator strengths

  • Comfortable owning pricing/margin for a specialized, judgment-heavy service line.

  • Excellent written communication; confident handling ambiguous regulatory questions in live customer settings.

Preferred

  • IAPP certifications (CIPP/E, CIPM, CIPT, FIP), formal DPO certification.

Success metrics

  • Utilization % and gross margin on privacy engagements.

  • Regulatory-change responsiveness time to update playbooks after new guidance/rules land.

  • QA pass rate, rework rate, CSAT.

  • Attach rate for privacy services; deal-unblock impact where privacy expertise was the gating factor.

  • Stepping in before someone has to step up.

  • Wearing multiple hats without counting them.

  • Leaving egos at the door and winning as one team.

  • Taking the harder right over the easier wrong.

  • Shipping, learning, repeating.

  • Staying curious and never staying in your lane.

How we care for our Sprinters

  • Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach.

  • Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance.

  • We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills.

  • We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to.

  • Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary.

  • Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you

You are welcome at Sprinto for who you are, and we encourage you to bring your complete selves to work. Our culture is built on the strength of diverse thinking when people with different perspectives, ideas, and ways of solving problems come together, it fuels collaboration and accelerates our mission.

descriptionFromApi:
Job Title: AI/ML Expert or Gen AI Engineer

Location: Hyderabad

Experience: 5 to 8 Years


Job Description:

Key Responsibilities:
- Design and deploy Gen AI solutions (e.g., chatbots, anomaly detectors) to automate incident triage, root cause analysis, and alerting in production environments.
- Integrate AI with existing tools like monitoring systems (e.g., Splunk, Dynatrace, Glass box, Catchpoint), ticketing platforms (e.g., Remedy or ServiceNow), and databases (e.g., Oracle) to improve observability.
- Develop custom AI agents or scripts using LLMs (e.g., Claude, Llama, GPT, etc.,) for natural language querying of logs, metrics, and codebases, accelerating MTTR from hours to minutes.
- Collaborate with production support teams to identify toil-heavy processes, prototype AI fixes, and measure impact via KPIs like resolution time and ticket volume.
- Build and maintain AI pipelines for continuous learning from production incidents, ensuring models improve over time without human retraining.
- Ensure AI solutions comply with security, data privacy, and reliability standards in high-stakes financial or enterprise apps.
- Train and upskill support teams on AI tools, fostering a culture of AI-driven efficiency.

Preferred Skills:
- Proficiency in Gen AI frameworks & Transformers for building RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems.
- Programming: Python (advanced), with experience in FastAPI, Streamlit for AI prototypes; SQL for database querying (Oracle preferred).
- Production support expertise: Incident management, log analysis, MTTR optimization in cloud (AWS/Azure) environment.
- AI ops: Model deployment via Docker/Kubernetes, monitoring with Prometheus/Grafana, handling drift and hallucinations.
- Data handling: Vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS), prompt engineering for domain-specific tasks like error prediction.

Desired Skills:
- MLOps tools: MLflow for CI/CD of AI models.
- Observability integration: Custom agents for tools.
- Domain knowledge: Global Banking, SRE practices (e.g., SLOs).
- Soft skills: Cross-functional communication, agile methodologies, experience converting AI in conservative teams.
- Emerging tech: Multimodal AI (e.g., vision for dashboard analysis), fine-tuning open-source models on proprietary incident data

Minimum Qualifications (MustHave) *

  • 58 years total experience, including 3–5 years of handson GenAI/automation work.
  • Strong Python skills for scripting, API integration, and automation

Job title: Testing- AI engineer

Location: Pune, HYD

Experience: 5+ Years

Work Mode: Hybrid


Job Description:

JD for AI Engineers:

  • Total Work experience ~5-10 years
  • Frontier agentic models: Knowledge of Frontier agentic models (OpenAI GPT, Google Gemini AI, Anthropic Claude etc.,) and building Agentic AI agents.
  • MCP with Testing agents Selenium, Appium, Playwright, JMeter, Roboframework, commercial tools like TOSCA, TDM, DevTest
  • Prompt Engineering & Evaluation: Prompting to solve a QA problem, Testing how agents respond to various instructions, chain-of-thought prompts, and few-shot techniques.
  • Programming: Proficiency in Python, TypeScript, JavaScript is required for scripting, analyzing agent traces, and customizing test environments. Rapid prototyping
  • System Architecture & Tooling: Ability to test AI interactions with external tools, APIs, databases, and web services (e.g., verifying tool selection and API payload accuracy).
  • DevOps expertise (SCM, Jenkins, Ansible)
  • Testing Expertise (Good to have):
    • Proficiency in testing tools, Agentic Testing Playwright, Performance Testing- Apache JMeter, API Testing tools Insomnia, Karate, REST Assured.
    • Writing scripts to automate test cases, debug, and monitor agent actions.
    • Validating agents functional and technical features, integration with external tools, APIs, and databases (e.g., LangChain, CrewAI).

Job Title : Senior Product Manager

Location : Bangalore; (Full Time, Onsite)

About Locus

Battle-tested in 350+ deployments across 30+ countries, Locus is an agentic Transportation Management System for all-mile, all-channel, trusted by enterprises like Unilever, Nestl , and Siam Makro.

The platform unifies orders, capacity, and carrier networks into one living plan, aligning planning, execution, and settlement so promises become proof. AI co-pilots with guardrails surface risk early and recommend the next best move to protect SLAs and reduce empty miles.

In 2025, Locus joined the Ingka Group (IKEA Retail) family, marking a major milestone in our journey. Backed by the scale and strength of IKEA, we continue to operate independently while accelerating our mission to make global supply chains faster, smarter, and more sustainable.

Our Journey and Impact

Since 2015, Locus has been on a mission to make logistics decision-making intelligent, sustainable, and real-world ready. Our platform has powered billions of deliveries across 30 + countries for global enterprises, driving measurable impact in cost savings, carbon reduction, and SLA performance. With the strength of the IKEA ecosystem behind us, we re scaling that impact even further.

Our Global Footprint

Headquartered in Bangalore, with teams across the U.S., U.K., UAE, and Southeast Asia, Locus brings together 170 + engineers, designers, and problem-solvers united by a single goal: to reinvent how the world moves goods.

Traits We Value

We look for people who are:

  • Global in mindset : curious about diverse markets and ideas.

  • Unrelenting in drive : energized by complex challenges.

  • Intelligent in approach : analytical, creative, and thoughtful.

  • Dynamic in execution : adaptive and decisive in fast-moving contexts.

  • Exact in craft : detail-oriented and committed to excellence.

About the role

Locus is rebuilding last-mile delivery as a multi-tenant SaaS platform. The DiSCO Mobile App is the driver-facing surface - used by drivers, 2-person crews, and hub-ops staff across enterprise tenants (IKEA, Giant Tiger, and the long tail of Locus customers).

The Senior PM will own one or more product modules end-to-end - Hub Depot Operations, Execution at Customer Stop, Returns Reverse Logistics, Multi-Trip Shifts, or Workforce Auth - from scoping with domain PMs, through workflow design with UX, to release readiness with the engineering pod and customer-onboarding teams.

The role partners with the Principal PM on overall app vision and runs its modules independently.


What youll do

  • Own a slice of the mobile app: scope it, write the spec, drive design partnership, shepherd it through engineering, land it in tenant rollouts.

  • Author mobile workflow specs (Delivery / Pickup / Hub Depot / Returns) and the matching epic + story tickets in Jira.

  • Coordinate with domain PMs (Execution, Hub Ops, Workforce, Order Management) to translate entity specs and design decisions into driver-facing scenarios.

  • Partner with UX on gap closure and with the mobile engineering pod on sequencing and delivery.

  • Own one or more enterprise tenant rollouts - translating customer requirements into product changes vs. tenant config, and holding the line on what is product-grade vs. one-off.

  • Uphold platform defaults: client-agnostic architecture, point-of-use permissions, plain-language UX, no over-engineered enterprise theatre.

What were looking for

  • 6+ years in product management, including 3+ years on enterprise SaaS or platform products. Mobile app PM experience is a strong plus.

  • Shipped in domain-heavy, multi-team environments - comfortable reading entity specs, sequence diagrams, and engineering RFCs, not just user stories.

  • Spec author. Can write a 3,000-word workflow doc that engineering, design, and customer success can all build from.

  • Strong opinions about driver / operator UX - has shipped for low-context, high-pressure mobile users (delivery, field service, frontline ops, warehousing).

  • Jira-as-source-of-truth discipline: every scope decision is a ticket, every blocker is a link, every spec gap is a child story.

  • Bias toward plain language, concrete examples, and decision-by-tradeoff over decision-by-framework.

Nice to have

  • Logistics / last-mile / supply-chain domain background.

  • Multi-tenant SaaS scoping experience (whats product vs. whats tenant config).

  • Comfort with domain-driven teams (DDD, event sourcing, entity-first specs


What We Offer

Join Locus and become part of a visionary team that is redefining logistics through innovation and smart distribution. We provide competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a collaborative environment where your expertise will drive both your growth and that of the organization.

Locus is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace.

This enables us to provide consistent, sustainable and high-performance infrastructure for hyperscalers and enterprises across the region.

Reporting to the Critical IT Director, this role is the regional owner of Digital Edge s mission-critical on-premises server infrastructure across our data centre portfolio. This is an estate of more than 100 physical servers, supporting more than 180 critical virtual machines. It unites deep engineering ownership of high-performance server clusters built on the hyperconverged infrastructure (HCI) concept with 24/7 operational excellence. The role owns the physical server hardware and the hypervisor layer that underpin the HCI platform; the operating systems and applications running within the virtual machines are managed by their respective owners and sit outside the scope of this role. The platform is vendor agnostic, and the role demands a deep understanding of the underlying technology stack of compute, virtualisation, software-defined storage and the management planes that bind them. The emphasis is not on deploying the latest and greatest virtualization technology, but on consistency of deployment and a disciplined operational mindset across the portfolio.

Key responsibilities:

  • Own end-to-end performance engineering of high-performance server clusters, establishing baselines and tuning compute, virtualisation and storage layers to eliminate bottlenecks across the stack.
  • Lead capacity planning and forecasting for the regional server estate, modelling workload growth and ensuring headroom for expansion without over-provisioning.
  • Define and track KPIs for cluster health, utilisation and efficiency, driving continuous optimisation of resource allocation and workload placement.
  • Benchmark and evaluate new server hardware generations and HCI software releases, validating price-performance before fleet-wide adoption.
  1. Infrastructure Strategy Resilience Architecture

Job Description

Platform Product Manager Pharma AI Platforms

We are looking for a Platform Product Manager who can identify, conceptualize and build the next generation of AI-enabled platforms for the pharmaceutical industry.

This is a highly research-oriented product role requiring someone who can understand complex pharmaceutical problems, investigate how those problems are currently solved, identify gaps in existing approaches, and translate those insights into differentiated platform products.

The role spans the Commercial, Clinical and Regulatory domains and requires the ability to connect diverse sources of pharmaceutical information in meaningful ways.

The ideal candidate will have strong credibility in understanding both formal pharmaceutical datasets and internet-based information sources and, more importantly, understand how these sources can be joined, contextualized and transformed into actionable intelligence.

For example, the candidate should be comfortable thinking about how clinical trials, scientific publications, regulatory filings, product labels, HCP information, commercial datasets, claims/RWD, conference information and other external sources can be brought together to answer questions that are difficult to solve using any individual dataset.

You will work closely with pharmaceutical business leaders, subject matter experts, data scientists, AI engineers and product engineering teams to take ideas from research problem definition product hypothesis platform capability customer validation scalable product.

This role is particularly suited to someone who enjoys operating in an environment where the problems are not always well defined and where significant value comes from discovering what should be built, rather than simply delivering what has already been specified.

Responsibilities

1. Identify High-Value Pharma Problems

  • Research and identify important, unresolved problems across Commercial, Clinical and Regulatory functions.
  • Understand how pharmaceutical organizations currently approach these problems and identify limitations in existing processes, data and technology.
  • Distinguish between incremental automation opportunities and problems that warrant a new platform capability.
  • Develop hypotheses around where AI, data and intelligent workflows can create significant business value.

2. Conduct Industry & Technology Research

  • Continuously track developments across pharma, biotechnology, healthcare data and AI.
  • Research emerging datasets, technologies, methodologies and business models relevant to pharmaceutical organizations.
  • Monitor scientific literature, clinical trials, regulatory developments, conference publications, industry reports, competitor products and emerging AI capabilities.
  • Convert research findings into potential product opportunities and strategic recommendations.

3. Build Pharma Data & Knowledge Strategies

  • Develop a strong understanding of both formal and non-traditional pharmaceutical data sources.
  • Evaluate how structured, semi-structured and unstructured datasets can be combined to solve specific business problems.
  • Explore relationships between sources such as clinical trials, regulatory documents, scientific literature, commercial data, HCP data, RWD and public internet sources.
  • Define data acquisition, enrichment, normalization, semantic and knowledge strategies required to support platform products.
  • Identify opportunities to create proprietary data assets and differentiated knowledge layers.

4. Define Platform Product Strategy

  • Translate identified problems into product visions, hypotheses and platform strategies.
  • Define reusable capabilities that can support multiple pharmaceutical use cases and customers.
  • Develop product roadmaps balancing immediate customer value with longer-term platform differentiation.
  • Define product requirements, user journeys, workflows, data requirements and success metrics.
  • Identify opportunities for common platform capabilities across Commercial, Clinical and Regulatory use cases.

5. Drive AI-Native Product Development

  • Work with AI and engineering teams to determine where technologies such as LLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agents, predictive models and intelligent workflows can create differentiated value.
  • Define appropriate human-in-the-loop, validation, explainability and governance mechanisms.
  • Establish product-level requirements for AI quality, accuracy, reliability and evaluation.
  • Ensure AI is applied to solve meaningful business problems rather than being used as a technology layer without clear value.

6. Customer Discovery & Validation

  • Engage with pharmaceutical executives, business leaders and subject matter experts across the US and Europe.
  • Conduct structured discovery to understand business problems, workflows, decision processes and unmet needs.
  • Validate product hypotheses through prototypes, experiments and early customer feedback.
  • Translate customer insights into product strategy without allowing individual customer requirements to turn the platform into a collection of point solutions.

7. Productization & Commercialization

  • Convert research concepts and customer experiments into scalable products.
  • Define MVPs, pilots and experimentation strategies.
  • Establish product-market fit through measurable customer outcomes.
  • Partner with commercial and consulting teams to articulate product value propositions and differentiation.
  • Develop product narratives that clearly communicate why Chryselys’ platform capabilities are difficult to replicate through conventional analytics, consulting or internal GCC teams.

8. Cross-Functional Product Leadership

  • Work closely with engineering, data science, AI, architecture, UX, pharma SMEs and consulting teams.
  • Translate complex business problems into clear product requirements and technical priorities.

  • Learn new tools when required without depending on a particular platform.

SEO and Digital Marketing Responsibilities

  • Conducting keyword research based on search intent, competition and business value.
  • Reviewing and improving website pages, landing pages, blogs, titles, descriptions, internal links and other on-page SEO elements.

  • Supporting SEO and paid search campaigns when required.
  • Coordinating with content, technical and management teams to complete marketing work.
  • Recommending practical improvements based on data and business priorities.

You may also be required to support other digital marketing activities depending on business needs. However, you are expected to prioritise work carefully and communicate when timelines or responsibilities need clarification.

  • Keeping up with important developments in AI and search without adopting every new tool or trend unnecessarily.

  • Website analytics tools.
  • Google Search Console.
  • SEO research and monitoring tools.
  • Reporting or dashboard tools.

Embark on an exciting journey into the realm of Agile delivery with 3Pillar! We are looking for a dedicated, pure-play Scrum Master to join our team on the Week strategic platform engagement.

At 3Pillar, we don't just write code; we craft cutting-edge technologies that revolutionize industries. The Scrum Master role is deliberately broad, spanning delivery, coaching, and teaching. You will not be "the person who removes blockers," but a facilitator of agility and a mentor for self-managing teams. If you are driven by a passion for building high-maturity, self-sufficient teams and are ready to make a real-world impact, consider this your pass to the captivating world of Product Development at 3Pillar!

Key Responsibilities

  • Coach Facilitate: Guide the team on Scrum and the Agile Manifesto; facilitate core ceremonies (stand-ups, planning, reviews, retrospectives) in a hands-off style asking questions and facilitating rather than directing or doing the work.

  • Empower Enable: Build self-managing teams, creating a safe environment that allows teams to fail and improve, driving toward self-sufficiency within a few months.

  • Partner with Product: Work in a co-empowering relationship with the Product Owner, coaching them on agile boundaries, backlog ordering, and creating value.

  • Metrics Improvement: Own agile metrics to surface insights that drive continuous improvement; use data evidence to push back constructively on unrealistic delivery dates and protect team flow.

  • Stakeholder Management: Manage stakeholders under executive scrutiny, operating confidently within defined escalation pathways to ensure concerns are heard at the right level.

  • Continuous Improvement: Stay with teams for the long term, driving sustained focus on maturity and supporting other Scrum Masters across the organization.

Qualifications

  • Agile Expertise: Strong command of the Scrum Guide and Agile Manifesto; practitioners must be operating at or close to an agile-coach level (not early-career).

  • Pure Scrum Master Role: This is a non-hybrid role; we are looking for dedicated Scrum Masters, not combined roles (e.g., SM/Business Analyst).

  • Coaching Influence: Proven experience in coaching and facilitating without authority; comfortable letting teams find their own pace.

  • Metrics Analysis: In-depth knowledge of agile metrics; ability to interpret data to drive improvement and protect team flow.

Additional Experience Desired

  • Workshop Facilitation: Experience in designing and running workshops, mindset exercises, and games for new and existing teams.

  • Emotional Intelligence: Ability to read team health through behavior, tone, and human interaction.

  • Missionary Mindset: Demonstrable track record of helping teams move from "cost-centre" mindsets to high-performing, mission-driven teams.

About the Role

We are looking for a sharp, intelligent, and highly organised professional to work closely with the Founders Office at Augmont.

This is a role for someone who can think, structure, write, coordinate, follow through, and use technology smartly to make work move faster.

The ideal person should be comfortable working with senior leadership, understanding business context quickly, converting discussions into clear notes, decks, trackers, decisions, and follow-ups, and bringing structure to fast-moving priorities.

This is not a routine EA role. It is a founder-office role where execution, clarity, discretion, and speed matter.

We are looking for someone who is AI-pro, tech-forward, and sharp enough to use modern tools, productivity apps, and digital workflows to improve quality and reduce manual effort.

Founders Office Support

  • Work closely with the Founder / Director on business priorities, reviews, meetings, and ongoing initiatives.
  • Understand discussions quickly and convert them into clear action points, summaries, trackers, and next steps.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, leadership members, external stakeholders, consultants, and partners.
  • Ensure important discussions do not remain only as conversations, but move towards closure.

Documentation, Decks & Communication

  • Prepare sharp business documents, meeting notes, summaries, proposals, and internal communication.
  • Create clean, well-structured presentations for reviews, business discussions, external meetings, and leadership updates.
  • Convert rough inputs, voice notes, meeting discussions, and scattered information into structured, usable outputs.
  • Maintain organised digital records of key documents, decks, trackers, and decisions.

AI-First Productivity & Research

  • Use AI tools, productivity apps, and digital workflows to improve speed, quality, and structure.
  • Support research, benchmarking, basic business analysis, and preparation for meetings or decision-making.
  • Create crisp briefs, comparison notes, and background material before important discussions.
  • Help bring better systems, smarter workflows, and cleaner execution into the Founder’s Office.

Follow-ups & Execution Tracking

  • Track founder-level priorities, pending matters, and action items.
  • Follow up with relevant stakeholders and ensure timely closure.
  • Coordinate across teams to remove information gaps and execution delays.
  • Prepare concise updates for leadership review.

Calendar & Meeting Management

  • Manage meetings, schedules, coordination, and day-to-day planning for the Founder / Director.
  • Ensure meeting preparedness, including agendas, documents, notes, context, and follow-up points.
  • Prioritise meetings and requests smartly, based on business relevance and urgency.

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • MBA or management background preferred.
  • Minimum 6 to 12 years of experience as Executive assistant/last 2-5 years in Founder’s Office, Strategy, Business Operations, Executive Associate, Management Trainee, Consulting, or similar roles.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent ability to create structured documents, decks, summaries, trackers, and business notes.
  • AI-pro, tech-forward, and comfortable using modern productivity tools to work smarter and faster.
  • Strong business understanding and ability to grasp context quickly.
  • Smart, proactive, discreet, detail-oriented, and reliable.
  • Strong coordination and follow-up skills, without needing constant reminders.
  • Comfortable working closely with senior leadership and handling confidential information.
  • Must be comfortable working full-time from office.

What We Are Looking For

  • We are looking for someone who brings clarity to chaos.
  • Someone who can sit in a meeting, understand what matters, ignore what does not, write the right notes, prepare a clean deck, follow up with the right people, and ensure things actually move.
  • Someone who is polished but not passive, smart but not theoretical, organised but not old-school, and genuinely AI-pro in the way they work.

If you are the kind of person who can bring structure, speed, and intelligence to a founder’s office, this role is for you.

Job Title: AI Engineer

Company: Outscale Partners

Location: Hybrid | Experience: 7 8 Years | Experience in AI: 4 5 Years | Openings: 2



About Outscale Partners

Outscale Partners (formerly AMH Services) is a Gurgaon, India-based global capability center (GCC) and strategic business solutions partner for the Argenbright Group, founded in 2022. It offers AI-enabled services in HR, finance, IT, legal, and customer support, focusing on rapid, scalable growth for enterprises



Role Summary

Reporting to the Senior AI Consultant, the AI Engineer will design, build, deploy, and operate AI systems across Unifi Service s enterprise platforms.

The role spans the entire AI lifecycle use-case identification, model and system design, production deployment, monitoring, optimization, and continuous improvement.



Core Responsibilities

Build and integrate AI-driven capabilities into enterprise applications and workflows using leading LLM platforms.

Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures to enable AI systems to securely leverage internal knowledge and data sources.

Develop and orchestrate AI agents capable of executing multi-step, decision-based business processes.

Own production AI systems end-to-end, including deployment, versioning, monitoring, scaling, and cost optimization.

Define, implement, and maintain evaluation metrics for AI quality, reliability, latency, and cost efficiency.

Collaborate closely with Leadership, Product and Engineering teams to identify, prioritize, and deliver high-impact AI solutions.

Ensure AI solutions follow enterprise standards for security, data privacy, reliability, and maintainability.



Must-Have (Non-Negotiable) Skills Experience

7 to 8 years of overall software engineering experience, with 3 to 4 years of hands-on work on production AI / LLM systems.

Strong proficiency in Python, with experience writing production-quality, testable, and maintainable code.

Proven experience designing and implementing RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, and response generation.

Hands-on experience with vector databases (e.g., Qdrant, FAISS, ChromaDb, or similar).

Practical experience using LLM orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Autogen, Haystack, or Semantic Kernel.

Prior experience building AI solutions in SaaS or enterprise-scale software environments.

Experience integrating with major LLM providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or Google Gemini.

Solid understanding of prompt engineering, context engineering (context window management), and output control techniques.

Experience deploying AI systems to cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP) using Docker and Kubernetes.

Working knowledge of LLMOps MLOps practices, including model versioning, CI/CD, monitoring, and rollback strategies.

Experience in implementing guardrails in AI Solutions along with Observability.



Preferred / Nice-to-Have Qualifications

Exposure to multimodal AI systems, model fine-tuning, or reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF).

Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP).

Understanding of AI cost optimization, latency tuning, and performance benchmarking in production.

Experience with domains such as eCommerce, Retail, HR, Finance, Legal, Compliance, etc



Language Documentation Expectations

All production AI code must be clearly documented, version-controlled, and supported by appropriate tests.

AI pipelines, prompts, and agent workflows must include design documentation and usage guidelines.

Each production AI system must have defined ownership, monitoring dashboards, and operational runbooks.

Clear documentation of model limitations, assumptions, and fallback behaviours is mandatory.




What We Offer

High-visibility role with direct access to senior leadership and decision-makers.

Opportunity to design and own enterprise-scale AI systems with real business impact.

Hybrid work arrangement, balancing flexibility with collaboration.

  • Implement and manage data governance policies, user roles, permissions, and Row-Level Security (RLS) to ensure data compliance and security.
Dashboard Report Development

  • Translate business requirements into clear, intuitive visualisations and self-service reporting solutions.

Job Title : Machine Learning Engineer

Job Type : Full-Time

Experience Level : Mid to Senior [5+ Years]

Department : Data Science / AI Engineering

Job Summary :

We are seeking a highly skilled and mathematically grounded Machine Learning Engineer to join our AI team.

The ideal candidate will have 5+ years of ML experience with a deep understanding of machine learning algorithms, statistical modeling, and optimization techniques, along with hands-on experience in building scalable ML systems using modern frameworks and tools.

Key Responsibilities :

- Design, develop, and deploy machine learning models for real-world applications.

- Collaborate with data scientists, software engineers, and product teams to integrate ML solutions into production systems.

- Understand the mathematics behind machine learning algorithms to effectively implement and optimize them.

- Conduct mathematical analysis of algorithms to ensure robustness, efficiency, and scalability.

- Optimize model performance through hyperparameter tuning, feature engineering, and algorithmic improvements.

- Stay updated with the latest research in machine learning and apply relevant findings to ongoing projects.

Required Qualifications

Mathematics & Theoretical Foundations :

- Strong foundation in Linear Algebra (e.g., matrix operations, eigenvalues, SVD).

- Proficiency in Probability and Statistics (e.g., Bayesian inference, hypothesis testing, distributions).

- Solid understanding of Calculus (e.g., gradients, partial derivatives, optimization).

- Knowledge of Numerical Methods and Convex Optimization.

- Familiarity with Information Theory, Graph Theory, or Statistical Learning Theory is a plus.

Programming & Software Skills :

- Proficient in Python (preferred), with experience in libraries such as : NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, Matplotlib, Seaborn

- Experience with deep learning frameworks : TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, or JAX

- Familiarity with ML Ops tools : MLflow, Kubeflow, Airflow, Docker, Kubernetes

- Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) for model deployment.

Machine Learning Expertise :

- Hands-on experience with supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning.

- Understanding of model evaluation metrics and validation techniques.

- Experience with large-scale data processing (e.g., Spark, Dask) is a plus.

Preferred qualifications :

- Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field.

- Publications or contributions to open-source ML projects.

- Experience with LLMs, transformers, or generative models

  • Working knowledge of test management tools, defect tracking systems, coverage dashboards, automation frameworks and traceability practices.
  • Experience applying automation, data analytics or AI-assisted methods to improve validation planning, execution tracking, reporting or defect insights.
  • Prior people management experience with demonstrated ability to hire, coach, develop and retain high-performing validation engineers and leads.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to present validation status, risks, technical issues and execution plans to engineering and business leadership.

Academic Credentials

  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a related technical discipline.
  • Equivalent industry experience in system validation, firmware, BIOS, driver, silicon validation or platform engineering will be considered.

Senior Design Verification Engineer

The Role

We are looking for an adaptive, self-motivative design verification engineer to join our growing team. As a key contributor, you will be part of a leading team to drive and improve AMDs abilities to deliver the highest quality, industry-leading technologies to market. The Verification Engineering team furthers and encourages continuous technical innovation to showcase successes as well as facilitate continuous career development.

The Person

You have a passion for modern, complex processor architecture, digital design, and verification in general. You are a team player who has excellent communication skills and experience collaborating with other engineers located in different sites/time zones. You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills and are willing to learn and ready to take on problems.

The verification team is looking for a Senior Design Verification Engineer to contribute on the verification of Network on Chip IPs, Subsystems having adequate knowledgeble on the boot flow. The individual will help architect, develop and use simulation and/or formal based verification environments, at block, subystem , Fulchip level, to prove the functional correctness of Network-On-Chip (NOC) IPs, subsystem and SOC designs.

Responsibilities

  • Plan verification of complex digital design blocks by fully understanding the architecture and design specification
  • Interact with architects and design engineers to create a comprehensive verification testplan
  • Design and architect testbenches in System Verilog and UVM to complete verification of the design in an efficient manner
  • Create and enhance constrained-random and/or directed verification environments, and formally verify designs with System Verilog Assertions (SVA) and industry leading formal tools
  • Debug tests with design engineers to deliver functionally correct design blocks
  • Identify and write coverage measures for stimulus quality improvements
  • Perform coverage analysis to identify verification holes and achieve closure on coverage metrics

General requirements

  • Experienced with development of UVM, OVM, VMM and/or System Verilog, Verilog test benches and usage of simulation tools/debug environments like Synopsys VCS, Cadence IES to test block level/full chip SOCs and FPGAs
  • Strong understanding of state of the art of verification techniques, including assertion and coverage-driven verification
  • Strong understanding of different phases of ASIC and/or full custom chip development is required
  • Experience in block level NOC (Network on Chip) verification is a plus
  • Verification Experience in protocols like AXI3/4, DDR4/5, HBM, PCIe, Processors, Graphics is a plus
  • Experience as a verification architect, establishing the verification methodology, tools and infrastructure for high performance FPGAs, SOCs and/or VLSI designs is a plus
  • Experience with gate level simulation, power verification, reset verification, contention checking, abstraction techniques is a plus
  • Familiarity with verification management tools as well as understanding of database management particularly as it pertains to regression management is a plus
  • Experience with formal property checking tools such as Cadence (IEV), Jasper and Synopsys (VC-Formal, Magellan) is a plus

Special Requirements

  • Architect and implement verification environment using advanced verification methodology such as UVM or SystemVerilog;
  • Test plan development and test writing;
  • Analyzing and debugging failures using simulation tools such as Synopsys VCS or DVE to verify hard IPs, FPGA fabric or System-on-Chip;
  • Functional coverage writing, coverage collection and analysis, coverage closure;
  • Writing System Verilog assertions and assertion based verification; and,
  • Running regressions, automation using scripting languages such as PERL and verification closure

Education Requirements

  • Masters / B.Tech / M.Tech
  • Years of Experience : 5+ Years

title: Principal Engineer-Physical Design
jobDescription:
Job Summary:

We are seeking an experienced Senior Principal Engineer / Senior Manager - Physical Design Lead to lead the implementation and delivery of next-generation, high-performance SoC products built on advanced process technologies. This role will be responsible for driving the complete physical design execution of large-scale SoCs, from floorplanning through tape-out, while achieving aggressive performance, power, area, and schedule targets.

The ideal candidate will have a proven track record delivering complex 3nm and/or 5nm SoCs, with deep expertise in physical implementation of extremely high-speed designs incorporating large digital subsystems, high-speed SerDes interfaces, mixed-signal blocks, and advanced power management architectures.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the end-to-end physical design execution of large and complex SoCs from floorplanning through GDS signoff.
  • Own implementation strategy, execution planning, risk management, and tape-out readiness.
  • Drive floorplanning, power planning, placement, clock tree synthesis, routing, timing closure, signal integrity, IR/EM closure, and physical verification.
  • Collaborate closely with architecture, RTL, verification, DFT, package, analog, and product engineering teams to optimize implementation quality and schedule.
  • Define chip-level implementation methodologies and best practices to achieve challenging frequency, power, and area goals.
  • Lead timing closure for complex multi-clock, high-frequency designs.
  • Partner with package and system teams to optimize overall product performance and signal integrity.
  • Drive implementation of advanced low-power architectures and ensure successful power-performance-area (PPA) optimization.
  • Lead physical design reviews, signoff reviews, and tape-out milestones.
  • Mentor senior physical design engineers and establish implementation excellence across the organization. Qualifications
  • Bachelors, Masters, or Ph. D. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related discipline.
  • 15-20+ years of experience in ASIC/SoC physical design.
  • Proven experience leading physical design teams for large-scale, high-performance SoCs.
  • Demonstrated success delivering advanced-node products, preferably at 3nm and/or 5nm technology nodes.
  • Extensive experience across: Floor planning and Partitioning, Power Planning, Placement and Optimization, Clock Tree Synthesis (CTS), Routing and Congestion Analysis, Timing Closure, Signal Integrity Analysis, IR Drop and Electromigration (EM) Closure, Physical Verification and Signoff.
  • Deep understanding of advanced-node implementation challenges including variation management, power integrity, and manufacturability.
  • Strong knowledge of industry-standard physical design and signoff flows.
  • Proven ability to lead large cross-functional teams and manage complex execution schedules.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience implementing:

  1. High-performance SoCs operating at aggressive frequency targets
  2. Large-scale switching and interconnect architectures
  3. Network-on-Chip (NoC) based designs
  4. High-bandwidth data movement fabrics
  5. Multi-billion transistor designs
  6. Experience integrating and closing timing on:
  7. High-speed SerDes subsystems
  8. Mixed-signal and analog IPs
  9. Advanced PHY technologies
  10. Memory controller and high-speed interface designs
  • Strong understanding of package-level and system-level impacts on physical implementation and timing closure.
  • Experience with advanced packaging and multi-die/chiplet architectures.
  • Exposure to AI, HPC, networking, data-center, connectivity, or memory infrastructure products.
  • Prior experience with high-performance switch fabrics, Ethernet switching, UALink, or similar interconnect technologies is desirable.
  • Advanced Low-Power Expertise (Must Have)
  • The successful candidate must have hands-on experience architecting and implementing advanced power optimization techniques in advanced-node SoCs, including:
  • Multi-voltage and multi-power domain designs
  • Dynamic Voltage and Frequency Scaling (DVFS)
  • Power gating and retention strategies
  • Clock gating methodologies
  • Adaptive power management techniques
  • UPF/CPF-based low-power implementation flows
  • Leakage optimization and dynamic power reduction
  • Low-power verification and signoff methodologies
  • Power-aware physical design and implementation closure. Disclaimer : This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Job Overview

This is a rare, high-visibility opportunity to sit within Reliance Retail's CEO's Office, as part of the newly formed Enterprise Acceleration Office (EAO) a small, high-impact team set up to drive the organisation's most critical, cross-cutting priorities. Working closely with the EAO Lead and senior business leadership, the incumbent will get direct exposure to CEO/CLT-level decision-making on some of the company's top strategic bets for the Fashion & Lifestyle (F&L) Business: AI transformation, operating model design, cross-division synergies, and innovation scale-up.

This is not a role for someone looking to only advise from the sidelines. The mandate blends structured analytical work — sizing opportunities, building the underlying business case, tracking execution data — with hands-on coordination to keep priorities moving on the ground. The incumbent should be comfortable rolling up their sleeves: running the numbers themselves, chasing follow-through, and coordinating with stakeholders to unblock delivery. The incumbent will work in direct partnership with the F&L Business leadership to frame priorities, align stakeholders, maintain execution pace, and resolve cross-functional blockers.


Activities / Responsibilities

1. Division Charter Ownership & Governance

  • Define, maintain, and govern the written charter for each active F&L Business priority, covering the objective, value case, milestones, decision log, and risk register.
  • Ensure the F&L Business CEO and CLT have a single, consolidated view of progress across all live priorities at all times.
  • Own escalation, review materials, and follow-through on decisions without substituting for division line accountability.

2. AI Transformation of the Division

  • Develop the F&L Business AI charter by identifying and prioritising use cases, and aligning business, data, product/technology, and operations teams on a shared roadmap and delivery timeline.
  • Work with stakeholders to drive adoption and value realisation across workstreams (such as Catalogue Intelligence, Merchandising Agility, Personalised Look Feeds, etc.).
  • Establish a measurement framework for each use case prior to launch; track AI-attributed GMV contribution as the north star metric.

3. Operating Model Implementation

  • Work with the F&L Business CEO to embed operating model requirements within F&L Business.
  • Identify gaps in accountability and follow-through and implement mechanisms to drive consistent execution across the division.

4. Cross-Division Collaboration

  • Identify and activate shared assortment, customer, monetisation, and supply chain opportunities across Reliance Retail divisions, with a specific focus on F&L Business category growth on JioMart and synergies with F&L, Electronics, and other formats.
  • Codify effective F&L Business interventions into documented playbooks and facilitate their adoption across other divisions within RRVL.

5. Innovation Scale-Up

  • Establish a pilot-to-scale pathway for F&L Business growth priorities with defined owners, milestones, funding logic, and phase-gate reviews.
  • Ensure all active innovation bets have a go/no-go framework to prevent inconclusive pilots from consuming ongoing bandwidth.

6. AOP Governance & Performance Management

  • Maintain weekly plan-vs-actual visibility across F&L Business priorities; identify risks early, coordinate intervention plans, and escalate trade-offs to the F&L Business CEO and CLT.
  • Ensure no at-risk priority goes without a documented intervention plan for more than two weeks.

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • B.Tech/B.E. from an IIT or NIT (Class of 2016–2019), with an MBA from an IIM or an Ivy League business school.
  • 7–10 years of total post-undergraduate experience, with a demonstrable mix of Tier-1 strategy consulting and operating/business roles.
  • Prior exposure to retail, e-commerce, D2C, or consumer businesses, either through client engagements or direct operating roles.
  • A clear, articulable track record of AI-first execution: having scoped, built, shipped, or driven adoption of an AI-powered product, workflow, or personal project.
  • Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills, with comfort operating at CXO/CLT interfaces.
  • Strong analytical and data-driven problem-solving skills, paired with the written and strategic communication ability to distil these into crisp, decision-ready presentations.
  • Equally comfortable building a business case as rolling up their sleeves to chase execution and follow-through on the ground - this role is as much about doing as it is about advising.
  • High ownership orientation - comfortable driving outcomes through influence across teams without formal line authority.

jobDescription:
Position Title : QA Engineer AI Voice Bot Testing


Role Summary

We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented QA Engineer to support testing activities for AI-powered voice bot solutions. The QA Engineer will work closely with the Testing Lead, Product team, Operations team, and Development team to validate business functionality, conversational workflows, and system integrations.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in software testing, automation, and production support, along with the ability to create and execute test cases based on Business Documents (BDs) and functional requirements.


Key Responsibilities


Functional & Business Testing

  • Review Business Documents (BDs), user stories, and functional requirements to create test cases and test scenarios.
  • Execute functional, regression, integration, and user acceptance testing for AI voice bot applications.
  • Validate conversational flows, business rules, API integrations, and escalation workflows.
  • Ensure voice bot responses and workflows align with business and operational requirements.

Collaboration & Coordination

  • Work closely with:
  • Testing Lead for test planning and execution activities.
  • Operations teams to understand customer interaction flows and business processes.
  • Product teams to validate feature requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Development teams for defect tracking and issue resolution.
  • Participate in sprint planning, requirement reviews, and release activities.

Automation & AI Testing Support

  • Support development and execution of automation test scripts and AI-driven testing solutions.
  • Assist in testing AI voice bots for:
  • Intent recognition
  • Response validation
  • Workflow accuracy
  • Business functionality
  • Contribute to improving automation coverage and testing efficiency.

Defect Management & Reporting

  • Identify, log, track, and retest defects using defect management tools. • Prepare test execution reports and communicate testing status to the Testing Lead.
  • Support production validation and post-release monitoring activities.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Software Testing, Application Support, or QA Engineering.
  • Strong understanding of software testing methodologies and QA processes.
  • Experience creating and executing test cases from Business Documents (BDs) and functional requirements.
  • Experience in functional testing, regression testing, integration testing, and API testing.
  • Exposure to AI Voice Bots, Chatbots, IVR systems, or Conversational AI platforms.
  • Knowledge of automation testing tools such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or similar.
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies.
  • Strong analytical and communication skills.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with Conversational AI platforms such as Dialogflow, Amazon Lex, or Microsoft Bot Framework.
  • Exposure to NLP and speech-to-text testing.
  • Knowledge of SQL, API testing tools (Postman, Swagger), and defect tracking tools (JIRA, Azure DevOps).
  • Experience supporting production releases and troubleshooting issues.

Reporting Structure

  • Reporting To: Testing Lead / QA Lead
  • Team Collaboration: Product, Operations, Development, and Support Teams

Success Metrics

• Accurate and comprehensive test execution.

• Reduced production defects and improved release quality.

• Increased automation coverage and testing efficiency.

• Timely defect identification and resolution support.

• Improved voice bot performance and customer experience.

We are looking for a visionary Chief Technology Officer (CTO) with a builder's mindset and a technology co-founder attitude to lead CoRover's next phase of innovation and global expansion.

This is not a conventional corporate CTO role. We are seeking a hands-on technology leader who can architect, build, scale, and own world-class AI platforms while contributing strategically to business growth. This opportunity is ideal for someone who has:

  • Served as a Founder, Co-Founder, CTO, VP Engineering, Chief Architect, or Engineering Leader.
  • Built and scaled enterprise-grade products from concept to production.
  • Led high-performing engineering organizations through rapid growth.
  • Strong expertise in distributed systems, cloud architecture, AI platforms, and scalable infrastructure.
  • Deep understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, Agentic AI, and Conversational AI.
  • A co-founder mindset with the ability to contribute to technology strategy, business growth, product direction, fundraising, and organizational vision.
  • Exceptional delivery orientation with the ability to execute large-scale enterprise implementations.
  • Experience mentoring engineering leaders and building leadership pipelines.

  • Designing products from first principles.
  • Solving complex technical challenges.
  • Building engineering culture.
  • Working closely with customers, partners, and investors.
  • Taking complete ownership of outcomes instead of simply managing teams.

Technology Vision & Architecture

  • Define CoRover's long-term technology vision and platform roadmap.
  • Architect highly scalable, secure, fault-tolerant AI platforms.
  • Build SaaS, On-Premise, Hybrid, and Sovereign AI deployments.
  • Lead platform modernization and enterprise architecture initiatives.
  • Define enterprise-wide security architecture, ensuring secure-by-design principles.
  • Establish best practices for cybersecurity, cloud security, data privacy, governance, compliance, and secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC).
  • Drive technology innovation while maintaining enterprise-grade reliability.

AI & Platform Engineering

  • Lead the development of Agentic AI, LLM, Conversational AI, and Multi-Agent platforms.
  • Build reusable AI frameworks and platform capabilities.
  • Optimize platform performance, scalability, latency, and reliability.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and drive innovation across engineering teams.
  • Establish engineering standards and architecture governance.

Engineering Leadership & Team Building

  • Build and scale engineering teams from 30 to 100+ members.
  • Recruit, mentor, and retain exceptional engineering talent.
  • Mentor Engineering Managers, Architects, and future technology leaders.
  • Build leadership succession plans across engineering.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning.
  • Establish engineering best practices, coding standards, design reviews, and quality benchmarks.
  • Build high-performing cross-functional engineering organizations.

Product Delivery & Project Management

  • Own end-to-end delivery of enterprise AI products and customer implementations.
  • Ensure predictable, high-quality, and timely delivery of strategic initiatives.
  • Lead cross-functional execution across Engineering, Product, QA, DevOps, Security, and Business teams.
  • Drive Agile and Scrum practices across engineering teams.
  • Manage engineering roadmaps, sprint planning, release planning, project governance, and delivery milestones.
  • Proactively identify and mitigate technical and delivery risks.
  • Balance innovation with enterprise-grade stability.
  • Own delivery KPIs, SLAs, uptime, and customer success metrics.

Product & Business Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Product Management, Sales, Customer Success, and Business teams.
  • Translate business goals into scalable technology solutions.
  • Drive customer-centric innovation.
  • Contribute to strategic product planning and technology investments.

Security, Governance & Compliance

  • Build secure, resilient, and compliant enterprise platforms.
  • Define cybersecurity strategy across infrastructure, applications, and AI systems.
  • Ensure adherence to global security standards, privacy regulations, and governance frameworks.
  • Implement secure coding practices, vulnerability management, penetration testing, disaster recovery, and business continuity planning.

External Leadership

  • Represent CoRover in enterprise, government, and strategic customer engagements.
  • Support fundraising, investor meetings, partnerships, and board-level discussions.
  • Act as a technology evangelist for CoRover.
  • Shape the company's technology vision in the market.
  • Function as a technology co-founder by contributing to strategic business decisions and long-term organizational growth.

What We're Looking For

Must-Have

  • 5-10 years of progressive engineering leadership experience.
  • Proven experience building and scaling enterprise technology platforms.
  • Strong expertise in distributed systems, cloud-native architecture (AWS, Azure, GCP), microservices, Kubernetes, DevOps, and platform engineering.
  • Strong delivery management experience with large enterprise customers.
  • Demonstrated expertise in project management and execution of large-scale technology programs.
  • Experience leading Agile/Scrum engineering organizations.
  • Strong system design and enterprise architecture expertise.
  • Experience managing multiple engineering teams simultaneously.
  • Proven experience mentoring engineering leaders and developing future technology leadership.
  • Deep understanding of cybersecurity, cloud security, application security, infrastructure security, identity management, and secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC).
  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and executive leadership skills.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to align technology strategy with organizational goals.
  • Ability to thrive in fast-paced startup and high-growth environments.
  • Experience working as a Founder, Co-Founder, CTO, or similar entrepreneurial leadership role is highly preferred.

Good to Have

  • Experience with AI/ML, Generative AI, LLMs, Agentic AI, and Conversational AI platforms.
  • Experience with Government, Public Sector, or Enterprise Digital Transformation projects.
  • Experience building multi-channel AI platforms (Web, Mobile, Voice, WhatsApp, IVR, Messaging).
  • Experience in SaaS and Enterprise Product companies.
  • Experience managing globally distributed engineering teams.
  • Exposure to MLOps, Data Engineering, AI Governance, and Responsible AI frameworks.
  • Experience contributing to product strategy, fundraising, and business scaling.
